title: Tracy - An intelligent application using decentralized storage and blockchain to manage pandemics

# Gitcoin Grant

## Rules
- Gitcoin grants should only serve funding of public good. See the explanation of public goods in [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_good_(economics)).
-  All the funding of the grant should go toward the goal stated in the grant.
 - It is forbidden to impersonate a person or an entity in the grant description.
 -  People giving money to the grant should only do so because they want the public good to be funded. It is forbidden to offer a reward to people funding the grant.

## Disputed grant
The disputed grant is the [Tracy - An intelligent application using decentralized storage and blockchain to manage pandemics ](https://gitcoin.co/grants/547/tracy-an-intelligent-application-using-decentraliz)

## Reason for the dispute
"First commit to their report was only 15 days ago, and most of the donors are new users, looks like they might be colluding"


Go to arbitrable application: https://resolve.kleros.io
question: Is this grant violating the rules?

titles: Yes, it is violating the rules.
